item: macOS: damaged-page tests run without dbstat; APFS name, kernel banner, tripwire watchdog
summary: Rows 87-91: the damaged-store helper reads b-tree pages off the file where SQLite has no dbstat (pinned equal to dbstat on Linux CI); bundle test accepts the designed unavailable split; erase test skips only the EILSEQ name APFS refuses; banner test reads uname; tripwire gets a faulthandler watchdog and backlog 8. No product gap.
